description_en: Query the list of authorization rules
name: ListAuthorizationRules

parameters.help_en: The ID of the 5G cloud instance.
parameters.name: wireless_cloud_connector_id

parameters.help_en: A list of authorization rule names.
parameters.name: names

parameters.help_en:
The type of destination. Valid values:  
Cidr: CIDR block  
Domain: Domain name or wildcard domain name  
IpPort: IP redirection
parameters.help_zh:
目标类型，取值：
Cidr: 网段
Domain: 域名或泛域名
IpPort: IP重定向
parameters.name: destination_type

parameters.help_en:
Protocol Type. Valid values:  
tcp  
udp  
icmp  
all: Supports all protocols.
parameters.help_zh:
协议类型。取值：

tcp。
udp。
icmp。
all：支持所有协议
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.help_en:
The destination port range. Valid values:  

For TCP and UDP protocols: 1–65535. Separate the start and end ports with a forward slash (/). Example: 1/200.  

For ICMP protocol: -1/-1.  

For ALL: -1/-1.
parameters.help_zh:
目标端口范围。取值范围：

TCP、UDP协议：1~65535。使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口。例如：1/200。

ICMP协议：-1/-1。

ALL：-1/-1
parameters.name: destination_port

parameters.help_en: The destination address, domain name, or wildcard domain name. Prefix matching is used.
parameters.help_zh: 目标地址、域名或泛域名，前缀匹配
parameters.name: destination

parameters.help_en:
The policy of the authorization rule. Valid values:  
Permit: Allow  
Deny: Deny  
Mapping: Redirection
parameters.help_zh:
授权规则策略，取值：
Permit：允许
Deny：拒绝
Mapping：重定向
parameters.name: policy

parameters.help_en:
The type. Valid values:  
System: System  
Default: Default  
Customer: Custom
parameters.help_zh:
类型，取值：
System: 系统
Default: 默认
Customer: 自定义
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The value returned from the previous page’s query. Do not pass this parameter when querying the home page.
parameters.help_zh: 上一页的查询返回的值，首页查询不传值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. The maximum value is 50, and the default value is 10.
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数，最大值为50，默认值为10
parameters.name: max_results

Destination.description_en: Destination IP address, domain name, or wildcard domain name, using prefix matching
Destination.description_zh: 目标地址、域名或泛域名，前缀匹配

Destination port range. Valid values:  

For TCP and UDP protocols: 1 to 65535. Separate the start port and end port with a forward slash (/). Example: 1/200.  
For ICMP protocol: -1/-1.  
For ALL: -1/-1.
DestinationPort.description_zh:
目标端口范围。取值范围：

TCP、UDP协议：1~65535。使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口。例如：1/200。
ICMP协议：-1/-1。
ALL：-1/-1

DestinationType.description_zh:

Status.description_en:
Status of the authorization rule. Valid values:
Creating: Creation in progress
Pending: Configuration in progress
Available: Valid and stable
Invalid: Invalid
Deleting: Deletion in progress

授权规则状态，取值：
Creating: 创建中 
Pending: 配置中
Available: 有效的稳定状态
Invalid: 无效
Deleting: 删除中

Type. Valid values:

NextToken.description_en: The starting token for the next query.
